{{Quote|Looks like a few Tusken Raiders have camped out on the Canyon Dune Turn.|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]|audio=Fode-TuskenRaiders.flac|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''Canyon Dune Turn''', also known as the '''Tusken Turn''', was a sharply curving canyon on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] along the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Mos Espa Raceway]], just outside the [[Laguna Caves/Legends|Laguna Caves]]. A vengeful tribe of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] known for shooting at passing racers was camped on the ridge overlooking the canyon.<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />

It was here that [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]] lost control of his [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] and crashed in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] race of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />
